parts.title: January 2026
parts.html:
Operations in the news

  • Operation Megaburu: Jharkhand Police with CRPF and CoBRA against CPI (Maoist) cadres in the Saranda forest, West Singhbhum.
  • Operation Trashi-I: counter-terror drive in Kishtwar (J&K) by the Army, J&K Police SOG and CRPF.
  • Operation Sahyadri Checkmate: the DRI busted a mobile mephedrone lab hidden in the Sahyadri hills.
  • Operation Absolute Resolve: US strikes on Caracas; Venezuela's President Nicolás Maduro and his wife were taken to the US on narco-terror charges.

Drills with partners

  • Sanjha Shakti: Army–civil coordination exercise at Diggi Range, Khadki Military Station, Pune; 350+ soldiers and 16 civil agencies.
  • 17th 'Dosti': trilateral coast guard exercise at Malé – India, Sri Lanka and Maldives.
  • India and Japan coast guards held a joint Hazardous and Noxious Substances (HNS) spill-response drill on ICGS Samudra Prahari, Mumbai.
  • Will for Peace 2026: naval exercise off South Africa with China, Russia and South Africa.
Dosti: coast guard exercise begun in 1991 between India and Maldives; Sri Lanka joined in 2012.

Navy and Coast Guard voyages

  • Sail training ship INS Sudarshini left Kochi on 'Lokayan 26': 10 months, 22,000 nautical miles, 18 ports in 13 countries, including the USA's 250th Independence Day event in New York.
  • Research vessel INS Sagardhwani (built by DRDO's NPOL) sailed from Kochi for the 5th Sagar Maitri mission with eight Indian Ocean countries, in line with MAHASAGAR.
  • ICGS Sankalp called at Port Louis, Mauritius.
  • The Navy's First Training Squadron (INS Tir, Shardul, Sujata and ICGS Sarathi) reached Changi, Singapore.
  • Submarine INS Sindhughosh (commissioned 30 April 1986) was decommissioned in Mumbai.
  • The Navy will set up a new naval base at Haldia, West Bengal.

Firsts in the forces

  • BSF raised the 'Durga Drone Squadron', its first all-women drone unit, trained at the Drone Warfare School, Gwalior.
  • Captain Hansja Sharma became the first woman Army pilot qualified to fly the Rudra armed helicopter.

Campaigns launched or running

  • Sampoornata Abhiyan 2.0 by NITI Aayog, 28 January–14 April 2026: full saturation of key indicators in 112 aspirational districts and 513 aspirational blocks.
  • Bal Vivah Mukt Bharat Abhiyan (WCD Ministry, launched 27 November 2024): child-marriage-free India by 2030. Balod (Chhattisgarh) became the first child-marriage-free district in 2025.
  • Vice President C.P. Radhakrishnan launched the Drug-Free Campus campaign at Delhi University on 13 January.
  • 2nd CISF Vande Mataram Coastal Cyclothon: two teams set off on 28 January from Lakhpat (Gujarat) and Bakkhali (West Bengal), to meet at Kochi on 22 February; theme 'Secure Coasts, Prosperous India'.
Prohibition of Child Marriage Act, 2006: marriage of a girl below 18 or a boy below 21 is child marriage; up to 2 years' rigorous imprisonment and/or Rs 1 lakh fine.
